title: OLEANDER Lighting Design Process v1.0 — Candidate
purpose: Develop daylight and electric-light environments as task, spatial, visual, control and maintenance systems tied to measurable/observable conditions rather than fixture styling or rendered brightness.
scope_in: controls, scenes, daylight response and user interaction
calculation, mockup, sample, aiming and commissioning readback
maintenance, replacement, post-occupancy tuning and change
scope_out: electrical system engineering approval or circuit protection design
universal illuminance/CCT/CRI/UGR or spectral thresholds detached from Current source
authority_position: Candidate R-E professional-domain process subordinate to OLEANDER Master Runtime, Current Knowledge Authority, Professional Domain Process Contract, Cross-Disciplinary Integration, project/jurisdiction/appointment authority and responsible Lighting Design professional. Current Architecture Map remains OPEN for Lighting Design until explicit promotion.

trigger.project_flow_trigger: A material project claim depends on Lighting Design professional judgment across one or more of: Lighting Brief, Visual Tasks and Operating States, Daylight and Luminous Concept / Spatial Hierarchy, Photometric, Brightness, Glare and Color-quality Development, Luminaire, Optics, Source and Architectural Integration, Controls, Scenes, Daylight Response and User Interaction, Exterior, Landscape, Façade and Night Environment, Mockup, Sample, Calculation and Design Verification, Specification, Procurement, Substitution and Construction Coordination, Commissioning, Aiming, Measurement and Actual Night Readback, Maintenance, Replacement, Post-occupancy Tuning and Learning.

knowledge_binding.consequential_knowledge_rule: Consequential Lighting Design methods, material/environment/site/product evidence and specialist facts must pass existing task/claim Operational Mount rules; candidate support extensions and project observations do not self-promote to Current Knowledge.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Lighting Basis / Visual Task / Experience / Operating-State Matrix
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Define visual tasks, users, adaptation, time/daylight/night states, spatial hierarchy, color/material context and operating scenarios that lighting decisions must satisfy.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Current architectural/interior/landscape/use evidence + applicable lighting criteria/source authority.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Retain only when task/state/context and criteria are explicit; lux target alone cannot define the professional lighting problem.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent lighting review challenges representative visual tasks, adverse states and strongest perceptual risk.

practitioner_object_contracts.object_name: Daylight / Photometric / Color / Glare Model Configuration & Assumption Register
practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Control exact geometry, sky/weather, material reflectance, photometric files, output factors, aiming, maintenance and calculation/view configurations.
practitioner_object_contracts.native_source_of_truth: Owner-native daylight/photometric models + current geometry/material/product/criteria sources.
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: No quantitative/perceptual claim may be retained without exact model configuration; a changed photometric/material/aim/control input stales affected results.
practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent review samples critical model inputs and governing outputs rather than only headline metrics.

practitioner_object_contracts.professional_purpose: Compare materially different luminous/spatial hierarchies, source/distribution, daylight integration, scene/control and night-environment strategies.

practitioner_object_contracts.revision_identity: option_id + common basis revision + option artifacts
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Do not count fixture brand/style swaps as concept families; compare causal luminous/spatial/control differences and adverse states.

practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent review compares strongest alternative and tests adverse visual conditions.

practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Plan/model/schedule/control/detail identity must remain aligned; rendered views and calculation PDFs cannot replace native model/configuration.

practitioner_object_contracts.independent_review_requirement: Independent lighting QA/QC on exact package/configuration and critical tasks/views.

practitioner_object_contracts.revision_identity: release_id + design requirement/model revision + submitted revision
practitioner_object_contracts.release_or_retention_rule: Physical fit or wattage similarity is insufficient equivalence; distribution/color/control/dimension/detail/maintenance changes reopen relevant evidence.

replacement equivalence gate when maintained-performance claims are made
assurance.independent_review: Attack generic checklist completion, presentation-only proof, source/revision mismatch, unresolved adverse states, hidden maintenance/construction conditions, owner leakage and project-evidence overgeneralization in Lighting Design.
